claims.claim_text: RL is known to be brittle and requires extensive task-speciﬁc hyperparameter search, which is infeasible in realistic simulators.
claims.normalized_text: RL brittleness and hyperparameter tuning challenges limit its performance in realistic simulators.
claims.source_quote: One reason is that RL is known to be brittle [12], and it is common to perform extensive task-speciﬁc hyperparameter search, such as 50 trials per environment as reported by Mnih et al.
